votes.motion: Nominate Karin Menard as Chair of the Park Commission, effective immediately.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Facilities Director estimated repairing all six benches at Veterans Park at $1,500; a resident offered to pay for the repairs, which the Select Board must approve.
budget_items.quote: he estimates that the costs of repairing all the benches would be $1,500.

budget_items.topic: Wallace Park merry-go-round swing and rails
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Replacing the two rails and the swing was estimated at $3,050.72, with the price rising July 1, 2025; the Commission then allocated that amount.
budget_items.quote: replacing the two rails and the swing is going to cost $3,050.72, and the price will increase by july 1, 2025.

budget_items.topic: Funding source for Wallace Park repairs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Facilities Director said the repairs would come from the revolving fund, and that funds were available; no amount was printed for the fund.
budget_items.quote: it would have to come from the revolving fund and that there are funds available.

budget_items.topic: Town Beach weed harvesting, capital account
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The weed-removal plan would be a three-and-a-half-day contractor job, followed by a reassessment of whether the capital account holds enough funds for more work; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: and then reassessing to see if there are enough funds in the capital account to move forward with more work.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The chair determined that just under $100,000 remains appropriated for Marshall Park, to be spent down on design.
budget_items.quote: she determined that there is just under $100,000 left that was appropriated for marshall park.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Some of the currently allocated Marshall Park funds are ARPA funds that must be spent down; a bathroom would need additional funding. No amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: some of the currently allocated funds are arpa funds and must be spent down.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Members cited a small revenue source against a large amount of spending, and proposed a Town Manager meeting on the finances; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: because of the small source of revenue that is being generated and the large amount of funding being spent.
